title: Altu Pilaranak lurayirinaka
intro: Mä jachʼa nayra markan tʼunjatanakap nayraqatanwa saytʼatätajja, jichhajj jachʼa pilaranakapajj tʼunjatäjjewa. Thayax ch’usat callinakanw warariski, nayrax uka uraqinak apnaqir wali ch’aman jaqinakan amtawip apt’ata. ¿Khitinakas jupanakajj utjäna?
clues: Jiwasax wali ch’amani ukat yatiñan jaqinakäpxtwa, jach’a utanakasat ukhamarak nayrar sartat civilización ukanakat uñt’atäpxtwa.
Ch’alla qullunakani ukat qala qullunakan mä uraqin jakasipkayäta, ukat janiw khitis atipañjamäkiti sasaw amuyapxirïta.
Mä yatiyirix pachpa wila masinakajatw jutäna, Allah saparukiw yupaychapxañajatak jawsapxitu, ukampis jiwasax janiw sasaw sapxirïta ukat larusipxaraktwa.
‘¿Khitis jiwasat sipansa jukʼamp chʼamani?’ sasaw jachʼañchasipjjayäta. ukat jachʼa jachʼa tukuñanakasampi, idolonakar yupaychañsa sarantaskakïna.
Allah jupax mä jach’a thaya apayanitu, uka thayax paqallq arumaw llätunk uruw thayt’awayi, taqi kuns t’unjawayi.
Jiwasajj ‘Ad, Iram marka lurayirinakäpjjayätwa, ukat destinojajj taqe khitinakatï qhepat jutirinakatakiw mä yatiyäwir tuküna.

outcome.label: ¿Kunas jupanakan qhepat pasañapäna?
options: Ukanakax t’unjatäxänwa ukat jiwat janchipax mä yatichäwiruw tukuwayxäna
Jupanakajj mä uraq khathati manqhan imtʼatäpjjäna
outcome.answer: Ukanakax t’unjatäxänwa ukat jiwat janchipax mä yatichäwiruw tukuwayxäna

arabic: تُدَمِّرُ كُلَّ شَىْءٍۭ بِأَمْرِ رَبِّهَا فَأَصْبَحُوا۟ لَا يُرَىٰٓ إِلَّا مَسَـٰكِنُهُمْ ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِى ٱلْقَوْمَ ٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ
verse: Destroying everything by command of its Lord. And they became so that nothing was seen [of them] except their dwellings. Thus do We recompense the criminal people. (46:25)
